prompt: This children's picture book illustration shows a whimsical chemistry laboratory with soft edges and pastel colors. In the center, a friendly bear wearing safety goggles pours purple liquid from a beaker into a flask, creating bubbling pink foam. To the left, a rabbit in a white lab coat holds a test tube rack with three colorful tubes, looking curiously at the bear. On the right, a mouse stands on a stool, reaching for a large green book titled with symbols on a high shelf. In the foreground, a frog sits on a table next to a magnifying glass and a scattered pile of crayons. Behind the bear, a chalkboard displays simple molecular drawings in white chalk. The mouse pushes the book slightly as the rabbit watches intently. A small bird perches on a Bunsen burner stand in the background, chirping happily. The lighting is warm and even, eliminating harsh shadows to maintain a gentle mood. Round tables and oversized equipment fill the space, making the science appear accessible and fun. The composition ensures all animal characters are clearly visible, with their expressions conveying wonder and cooperation in this safe, imaginative educational setting designed to spark curiosity in young readers.
